items.prompt: A bag has 5 red counters, 3 blue counters and 2 green counters. Pick one without looking. Which statement is correct?
hints: Count how many of each colour there are.
The colour with the most counters is the most likely.
Certain means it must happen every time.
items.explanation: There are more red counters than any other colour, so red is the most likely. It is not certain, because blue and green are also in the bag.

options.text: Blue and green are equally likely.
options.why: There are 3 blue and 2 green, so blue is a little more likely.

options.text: Green is more likely than blue.
options.why: There are fewer green counters than blue counters.

options.text: Red is the most likely colour.

options.why: Red is not certain because there are other colours in the bag.

items.prompt: You roll a normal dice. Put these events in order, from least likely to most likely.
hints: A dice has the numbers 1 to 6.
One event cannot happen at all, and one must happen.
Compare how many numbers make each event happen.
items.explanation: A 7 is impossible. A 6 is 1 out of 6. An even number is 3 out of 6. A number less than 7 is certain.
